evidence.reason: The adjustment subtracts every reservation whose timestamp is >= the usage observation time, but that timestamp comparison cannot distinguish a reservation already counted in the `backfill_starts_at_observation` checkpoint from one created after the observation. A same-timestamp reservation that is already included in the checkpoint is therefore incorrectly removed from the starts delta, undercounting ordinary starts and allowing over-admission despite outstanding reservations. Changing `>=` to `>` would only shift the tie problem; the fix needs checkpoint membership, as the finding states.
